primary_accuracy_metric: median across equally weighted participant-condition-target cells; cell value is median target error of its marker-window means
primary_spread_metric: median across equally weighted participant-condition-target cells; cell value is median radial spread of repeated marker-window means
decision_rule: start at 0.0500 s; use a longer client candidate only when participant-level paired bootstrap shows a clear improvement in accuracy or spread without a clear worsening of the other; otherwise prefer the shorter delay
meeting_interpretation: primary comparison is exactly 0.0500, 0.1000, and 0.1500 s; the meeting also requires separate calibration, 10-minute, and 60-minute views and a final shortest-equivalent recommendation
openet2_reference_warning: the OpenET2 v1.5 reference figure used target_settle_time_s=0.6000 and paper-style target-mismatch/MAD filtering, so it is a visual/statistical reference only and is not evidence for choosing 0.6000 s in Demo B
ellipse_role: post-selection empirical 95% coverage QA; excluded from delay score
coordinate_interpretation: Approximate dataset-specific scores on a fixed display-FOV grid; not measured physical visual angles.
